title: Battle of Cape Spartel
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Cape Spartel", at revision 1372250096, opens: "The Battle of Cape Spartel was an indecisive naval battle between a Franco-Spanish fleet under Admiral Luis de Córdova y Córdova and a British fleet under Admiral of the Blue Richard Howe. These forces met on 20 October 1782 after Howe successfully resupplied Gibraltar, then under siege by Bourbon forces during the American Revolutionary War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1781080, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1782 naval battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane overridden by hand, deviation 1553's class as ceuta-under-muslim-rule already is: Cape Spartel is the northwest tip of Morocco, and at the 110m resolution of data/geo/regions.json the europe polygon is 0.1102 degrees from its point and africa 0.1658, so the deriver took the wrong shore.
